current_bottleneck: 641a solves the methodological gluing objection: IV and anchor factors are generated by one shared joint38 state-conditioned flow with shared memory, velocity, rollout, and randomness. last_result_summary: 641a trained one native 38-channel mixed-coordinate model: iv:* channels generate level-score deltas, factor:* channels generate encoded increments. next_step_recommendation: Run post-experiment analysis before adding more knobs. Keep 641a as the clean native joint baseline, but do not add more coordinate branches. The next principled target is unified conditional spread/location calibration inside the same one-model path law, likely through objective/sampling changes rather than separate IV and factor treatments.
